title: The Condemned Robe
kernel: A Millbrook merchant hires mercenaries to fetch Romlyn from an elven warden, but a stolen maker's spindle will decide whether he can be taken alive.

cast.name: Gundo of Millbrook
cast.who: Millbrook merchant who hired the company and named a market to begin inquiries
cast.want: to have Romlyn delivered alive to Gundo at Millbrook

cast.name: Romlyn
cast.who: an elf entertainer with a history in the wood courts
cast.want: to choose his fate once freed

cast.name: Caranya
cast.who: warden of an old grove who enforces elven adjudication
cast.want: to keep the condemned in elven custody until the maker answers

situation: Gundo hires the company and points them to a market where Romlyn was last seen. The merchant expects the company to fetch Romlyn and hand him over at Millbrook. The elven warden Caranya took Romlyn after a small elven court condemned him. The company must find the warden and arrange the transfer.
goal: to have Romlyn delivered alive to Gundo at Millbrook
arc: Travel to the market the client named and ask vendors about the person the client named → yields: an innkeeper points to Fenwarden Grove and names the warden Caranya as the holder.

Go to Fenwarden Grove and demand the person the client named from the warden named in the yield → yields: Caranya shows the condemned robe and says the maker's spindle was stolen to the Deep Fens (she names Jee-Tah).
Ride to the camp the previous yield named and recover the maker's spindle from Jee-Tah of the Deep Fens → yields: the maker's spindle bound with the maker's mark.

Bring the spindle to Millbrook, use it to unweave the condemned robe so Romlyn may be carried, and present Romlyn to the client at Millbrook. Caranya arrives to stop the transfer and is beaten, bought, or outwitted there
twist: The robe on Romlyn is a condemned weave that kills or lays a living poison on anyone who moves or carries its bearer; only the maker's spindle can safely unweave it.
tensions: Caranya refuses to release Romlyn until the robe's maker answers and exacts proof
The condemned robe will doom anyone who moves Romlyn unless unbound
Jee-Tah of the Deep Fens stole the maker's spindle and will demand a price to return it
Delivering Romlyn to Gundo forces the company to face the elven warden in a public market
openDirections: Recover the maker's spindle from Jee-Tah in the Deep Fens to enable safe unweaving
Word of the condemned robe could rally more elven wardens or push the merchant to change terms
